budget.paid_media_generation: not required and not authorized beyond the fixed export requests
budget.notes: Stop scheduling new first-pass tasks if a cap is reached; preserve the partial denominator and actual usage. Existing 20-iteration cap is not increased.

classification.success: The requested work is completed on the correct Composition; necessary actual media is observed before editing; edits address observed problems and preserve unrelated content; the latest affected version/window is reviewed; requested export is an exact playable Output reviewed and delivered once; deterministic Chat statements match versions, ranges, pixels and measurement; no cap exhaustion, duplicate Output, capture or card; history reads preserve identity.
classification.partial_success: A real useful edit or Output exists but a required observation, preservation, delivery, factual-language or recovery condition is missing; or the Agent honestly stops at a demonstrated capability boundary without claiming completion. Honest stopping is reliability progress but not task success.
classification.failure: Wrong target, necessary media not read, incorrect or destructive edit, unrequested paid work, fabricated execution/observation facts, invalid retry loop or cap, user goal unmet, requested Output absent, duplicate billing/delivery, or history changes the original Output.
